priority: GBA portrait first; GB/GBC same shell

geometry.purpose: optical preview only, NOT fixed Android dp
geometry.gameSafeArea: measured actual available AndroidView viewport after system bars/cutout; contain fit core aspect
geometry.gbc: same physical shell and 10:9 source geometry as GB

psx.overflowRule: landscape or larger control workspace if essential keys cannot fit; never suppress needed inputs

nds.future: two independent aspect-safe game surfaces in shared CARTDECK family; no single forced stretch

presentation.skeleton: continuous chamfered chassis with screen inset, shallow bezel depth, small C-slot header, lower integrated controller deck
presentation.dpad: reuse canonical chamfered cross, never circular disc or four isolated arrows
presentation.systemLabel: small removable GB/GBA badge adjacent to bezel, not manufacturer device branding
presentation.decorativeEffects: subtle bevel and focus only; no animation over game image

layersInFrontToBack: reusable decorative control/indicator accents outside game
bezel and chassis overdraw with literal game-window hole
single existing AndroidView LibretroDroid game renderer

responsiveness.portrait: screen first then controls, safe edges
responsiveness.narrow: scale decoration down ahead of functional hit targets
responsiveness.landscape: same chamfered family, game-first, flank control groups as available
responsiveness.gestureZone: no essential virtual button within Android bottom gesture strip
responsiveness.textScale: do not scale hard body with fontScale

reviewOrder: Jonathan and Cassia lock portrait silhouette, game-first balance, D-pad, bezel
Daniel checks measured GL viewport and PadKit touch hit-zone independence
Marcus tests real games, multi-input, saves/update continuity
noChangesTo: PadKit input IDs or key bindings
